title: Kashkavalikos
subtitle: flower-shaped kashkaval burekas
description: Turkish pilas pastry brushed with butter and covered with kashkaval, cut into squares and rolled into flower-shaped burekas.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C on turbo (fan-forced) and line a tray with baking paper.
Spread the pastry on the work surface and brush generously with the melted butter. Scatter the coarsely grated kashkaval over all the pastry and press down with your palms.
Cut the pastry in half across and then into squares of about 10 cm.

Make 6 cuts in each square with a pizza cutter, 1 cm apart, leaving a 1 1/2 cm border uncut at the top and bottom. Roll the pastry square diagonally from the right corner into a small roll and fold into a flower shape. Place on the tray.
Bake for about 25 minutes until nicely golden.
Best served the same day, but it keeps in the fridge for up to two days; reheat in a hot oven before serving.
